text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After many busy days of attending
workshops and
meetings, I finally have a
moment to rest, when...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
What is the meaning of this? Your
workspace is
covered in dust, trash, and
loose documents—it's
filthy!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I meant to return to work after delivering these handouts to you, but I can't leave this office like... this.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
A cluttered room is a reflection of a
cluttered
mind. Now, up on your feet. I'll
help, but we're
taking care of this
immediately.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm suddenly subjected to a one-on-one
crash
course on cleaning.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Open the windows and go get a trash
bag ready!
We'll start by clearing your
desk!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Throw away everything you don't need!
Gather up
all the trinkets you have lying
about... Hey, don't
just throw those
loose paperclips in the drawer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The cleaning session proceeds quickly,
thanks to
her strict, yet precise
instructions.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I think we've finished for the most part. All that's left is to dispose of the trash and sort these documents.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've come this far, I might as
well see
this through to the end. We'll
split the final two
tasks. Which do you
prefer I handle?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Perhaps I should warm up
before
tackling this mountain of
rubbish...
choice_data_list: Could you please help organize these documents?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Urk! This is... nothing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, my office is
spick-and-span.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. It's only natural for fellow
employees
to assist each other. Now, if
you'll excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I foresee a great deal of muscle pain for
me
tomorrow...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
While file organization is my forte, this
huge pile
is rather daunting. But very
well.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Save, toss, unclear, toss, save, unclear...
I knew
what to expect going into this,
but the sheer
volume complicates things.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I didn't realize this task would take so
long.
Perhaps it's time we consider
moving away from
using printouts to
share information.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I should report my findings to URA's
upper
management.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I receive a survey
about whether
the academy should
begin using paperless
methods to
distribute information.
